goal: Centralize public-subagent resume policy: when resuming a public subagent through the root `agent` tool or a public child's ownership-scoped nested `agent` tool, omitted fixed settings (inherit_context, isolated, pair, profile, system_prompt) reuse the stored session choices, including a stored true for inherit_context and isolated. Explicitly changed settings are rejected before resume and leave the stored choices unchanged. A blank system_prompt counts as omission. run_in_background stays changeable on every invocation. Ownership checks and new-session defaults (false) do not change. Pi's argument validation keeps an omitted value distinct from an explicit false. Both callers share one policy in the invocation-policy module, and the docs and guidance are updated.
